slides.prompt: What do you do every day?
slides.notes: 60-min Mon lesson, sl_m3. Retrieval from 31-Aug routine lesson and 18-Aug present continuous. Outcomes (teacher-kept): choose time words and verb forms for routines vs right-now actions; complete Module p32 A-C.

options: Monkeys often swing from tree to tree.
The birds are building their nests now.
slides.answer: Monkeys often swing from tree to tree.
slides.feedback: Often signals a routine, so the verb stays simple.
slides.notes: Module p32 Grammar Notes contrast. Grammar book: simple describes routine behaviour, a fact about the person.

slides.feedback: Routine words team with the simple verb. Right-now words team with am, is, are.
slides.notes: Teacher clicks the team the class proposes. Caveat for teacher: signal words are clues, not absolute rules.

slides.feedback: Tigers always rest there. A fact about tigers.
slides.notes: Fresh parallel of Module B1 (pandas). Click fills the blank inline; Reset clears it.

slides.sentence: Look! The baby elephant {{blank}} water at visitors.
slides.feedback: Look means it is happening now.
slides.notes: Fresh parallel of Module B2. Grammar book: continuous marks temporary, incomplete actions.

slides.prompt: Which word fits a Saturday routine?
slides.feedback: Sometimes teams with routines. At the moment teams with now.
slides.notes: Quick check before the picture contrast.

slides.prompt: What changes between the two sentences?

columns.label: Every day
columns.text: The giraffe eats leaves from trees.

columns.label: Right now
columns.text: The giraffe is eating leaves from a tree.

slides.notes: Module C model pair. Expected: eats vs is eating; routine vs now.

slides.task: Open Module p32. Do A (time words), B (verb forms) and C (picture sentences) in your book.
slides.frame: Routine: often, sometimes, every day + verb. Right now: now, at the moment + am, is, are + verb-ing.
slides.notes: About 20 min individual. Frame revealed on request. Collect books after per teacher routine.

slides.prompt: Say one routine sentence and one right-now sentence.
slides.hint: Start with Every day and Look.
slides.notes: Exit evidence, oral pairs, 3 min. Listen for verb choice matching the signal word.
